text: dsh-text-color-adaptive（DSH 网页插件）：根据当前壁纸画面采样亮度并调整标签文字颜色，让文字在不同背景上保持清晰。插件通过定时采样壁纸媒体，结合当前深浅主题估算文字背后的颜色，再设置主文字、次要文字、说明文字等层级的颜色和阴影。壁纸或画面无法采样时会撤销自定义样式，避免影响 DSH 原有文字显示。不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-text-color-adaptive samples wallpaper brightness and adjusts DSH label colors for readability. It adapts text colors and shadows to the light or dark theme, and removes its styles when sampling is unavailable. No API key or external service is required.
让 DSH 根据壁纸自动调整标签文字颜色
Keep DSH labels readable over changing wallpapers
深色主题的文字放在亮壁纸上看不清，怎么改善？
dsh-text-color-adaptive 的功能「壁纸自适应标签颜色」：定时采样壁纸区域亮度，为 DSH 标签文字选择浅色或深色，并设置不同文字层级和阴影；没有可用采样时会移除自定义样式。

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · dsh-text-color-adaptive：Recolors DSH label text from the actual brightness of whatever is behind it, so white text on a bright wallpaper stops washing out.

Built for the transparent-glass look (a wallpaper plus semi-transparent panels): the shipped dark-theme text color is a fixed near-white, and a live wallpaper keeps moving bright frames underneath it. This plugin measures that backdrop and picks a side — light text or dark text — instead of assuming one.

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · What it does：Every 0.9 s it samples the wallpaper layer (`.we-layer`, produced by [dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine)) — an ``, `

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · What it does：The frame is scaled to 64×36, the text column is averaged into one background color, and that color is blended with the active theme's glass surface to estimate what the glyphs actually sit on. It then picks the side with the higher contrast and pushes the color until it just clears 4.6:1.

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · What it does：It writes five tokens — `--dsw-alias-label-primary`, `-secondary`, `-tertiary`, `-caption`, `-dimmed` — plus a text shadow that runs opposite to the text color (dark text gets a light shadow and vice versa) as a safety net.

Switching sides is damped: the new side has to beat the current one by 1.15× on two consecutive samples, so a live wallpaper does not flicker.

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · When it cannot sample：No wallpaper layer, a frame that is not decoded yet, or a scene iframe that refuses `__wp.capture()` (cross-origin) — the plugin turns itself off completely (removes `html[data-at-adaptive]`) and leaves DSH's own colors untouched. It never leaves half an override behind.

Without the wallpaper plugin there is nothing to sample, and DSH's solid background needs no help; the plugin stays dormant.

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · Tuning：Constants at the top of `client.js`:

| Constant | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `FLOOR` | 4.6 | Target contrast for body text (WCAG AA is 4.5:1) |
| `SURFACE_MIX` | 0.45 | How much of the backdrop is glass surface; raise it if your glass is thicker |
| `TICK_MS` | 900 | Sampling interval |
| `SWITCH_MARGIN` / `SWITCH_STABLE` | 1.15 / 2 | Side-switch margin and stability count |

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-text-color-adaptive
```

dsh-text-color-adaptive README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-text-color-adaptive
```

`__dshAdaptiveText.dispose()` turns it off for the current page without uninstalling.
